scope: Candidate host contract; no runtime or physical readiness

protocol.edhoc: RFC 9528 method 0 suite 2, message 4 required, no EAD
protocol.profile_hash: SHA-256 of these exact profile.json bytes

route.properties: central writes with response; peripheral notifies; require subscription before starting
route.selection: exactly one of this service and each characteristic on the current connection; service presence is not authentication; absence or incompatible properties fail closed, with no legacy fallback

framing.header: magic 4f48, wire version 3, kind 2, flight 1..8, total length u16 little endian, fragment index u8
framing.flight_lengths: flights 1 and 2 exactly 64 bytes; flights 3 to 6 from 1 to 256 bytes; flights 7 and 8 exactly 48 bytes
framing.correlation: one current non-reused connection generation and complete untrusted prelude attempt UUID; discard partials on disconnect
framing.compatibility: wire v3/kind 2 on this service is distinct from field-handshake v2 phone Bluetooth and radio; reject other version, kind, route and characteristic

binding.authority_context: device-authority v1 context of current eligible exact CORE-LINK policy and both owner records
binding.fields: proof-context field v1: profile hash, attempt, authority context, LINK and CORE UUIDs, public-key hashes, boot IDs and fresh nonces, authenticated TH_4
binding.trust: independent configured factory credentials and eligible durable authority on both endpoints; resolve exact intended peer; validate current authority and generation through every asynchronous boundary
binding.confirmation: field-handshake v2 export and protected confirmations using this exact profile hash and kind 2; initiator receives flight 8; responder verifies flight 7 and caches exact flight 8 to original deadline

keys.identity: use a device-owned signing operation or opaque provider handle; never export a permanent identity scalar to application code
keys.traffic: two distinct 16-byte exporter keys for LINK-to-CORE and CORE-to-LINK using existing initiator/responder traffic labels and this profile-bound export context
keys.adoption: after local confirmation and a fresh current-authority and connection check, transfer both directional keys and exact attempt context once to the serialized radio owner; all-or-nothing acceptance, no caller retention, logging, persistence or reinstallation of the same material. A serialized owner guard prevents use before final current-state validation.
keys.failure: failed, partial, stale, cancelled, superseded or uncertain adoption synchronously invalidates and disables the candidate and zeroizes all owned temporary copies; a failed or uncertain invalidation leaves the radio owner disabled until safely reset. The radio owner cannot use an uncertain partial handoff
keys.lifecycle: clear temporary secrets on cancel, error, disconnect before handoff and reboot; fresh boot requires fresh authentication. Radio-ready requires separately authenticated bidirectional evidence. After successful handoff Bluetooth disconnect alone does not reset radio counters or replay state.
keys.radio_interface: existing development Exchange has one key and is not this two-direction adapter; C8.9 must implement and test direction, nonce, replay, atomic handoff and preservation of airtime and retained work

timing: one active serialized attempt per endpoint, with injected monotonic absolute deadline; duplicates and retries do not extend it. Numerical runtime limits and composed resource budgets remain C8.1.7/C8.9 gates. Backward, unknown or expired time fails closed.
recovery: preserve installed authority, unsynced reports and airtime on any failure; discard ephemeral candidate keys. Reconnect starts a new generation and fresh attempt. An already configured remote reboot needs fresh radio-only authentication under its separately specified profile.
